projects.name: MatterVial
projects.description: Hybrid materials-informatics framework combining feature-based descriptors, graph neural networks, and symbolic regression for accuracy + interpretability. Basis of my first-author npj Computational Materials (2026) paper.

projects.name: VibroML
projects.description: Automated toolkit for high-throughput vibrational analysis and dynamic-instability remediation of crystalline materials using machine-learned potentials. arXiv preprint 2026.

projects.name: MEIDNet
